name: Nabana Juna
source:
If she starts running she can't stop!? A girl who loves the track and field.

Shinano's friend. In charge of being lively. She's totally full of life, vitality incarnated - and really, isn't that the most important thing? She's laid back, but surprisingly serious about her club activities.

A girl who's at the age where she loves moving her body whenever there's time to spare.
